tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Wooli blue, Trips' travel blue: primary buttons, links, toggles, selected states, the needs-review dot, sparkles, BarGauge fill, the Loved stamp. As text on card/background 5.2/4.6:1 light, 6.3/7.6:1 dark. Text on a brand fill is on-brand. Proposed; the app code has #2563eb / #3b82f6.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed state, and brand text on brand-soft (secondary buttons): 6.1:1 light, 7.2:1 dark. Proposed; the app code has #1d4ed8 / #60a5fa.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill and tinted panels behind brand content. Proposed; the app code has #eff6ff / #172554.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icons on a brand fill: white 5.2:1 light, navy ink 6.7:1 on the lighter dark-theme blue.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background: a pale sky blue in light, the Trips globe's night ocean in dark. Never plain gray. Proposed; the app code has #f9fafb / #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card surface (the globe's ocean blue in dark); also the label colour on a selected RangePicker chip. Proposed; the app code has #ffffff / #171717.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card hairline, ItemRow dividers and the logo ring. Proposed; the app code has #e5e7eb / #262626.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of BarGauge and other bars. Proposed; the app code has #f3f4f6 / #262626.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, a deep navy ink: 17.1/15.4:1 light, 14.3/17.3:1 dark on card/background. Also the NOW chip and the selected RangePicker fill. Proposed; the app code has #111827 / #ededed.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, periods, metadata (6.4:1 or better on card and background, both themes). Proposed; the app code has #6b7280 / #a3a3a3.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: SectionLabel, ItemRow subtitles, placeholder icons, the Skip stamp (4.5:1 or better, both themes). Proposed; the app code has #9ca3af / #737373.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Money in and good changes: 5.0/4.6:1 light, 9.7:1+ dark. Reserved for money; always with an arrow or sign. Proposed; the app code has #16a34a / #22c55e.

tokens.name: expense
tokens.usage: Money out, bad changes, the review-count badge: 6.0:1+ in both themes. Reserved for money; always with an arrow or sign. Proposed; the app code has #ef4444 / #f87171.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending amounts, Uncategorized, sync warnings, PendingBadge text; 5.0/4.5:1 light, 9.6:1+ dark. Always with the word Pending. Proposed; the app code has #d97706 / #fbbf24.

tokens.name: pending-soft
tokens.usage: PendingBadge fill; pending on it is 4.6:1 light, 8.6:1 dark. Proposed; the app code has #fffbeb / #451a03.

tokens.name: last-month
tokens.usage: Last month's line and bars in spending-pace charts, a quiet comparison (always labelled). Proposed; the app code has #d1d5db / #525252.

tokens.name: this-month
tokens.usage: This month's line and bars in spending-pace charts, in brand blue (5.2:1 on card) against the quiet last-month.

tokens.name: ticket-start
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the hero gradient: TicketCard (Trips), HeroCard on every other overview, and the Review flow. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: ticket-end
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of the ticket gradient; white text is 5.2:1 or better across the whole ticket. Proposed; the Trips code ends on #3b82f6 (white text 3.7:1).

tokens.name: on-ticket
tokens.usage: All text and icons on a ticket, eyebrows included. Show hierarchy with size and weight, not by fading the white.

tokens.name: ticket-panel
tokens.usage: Inset rows on a ticket, a darkened pane (white text 6.3:1+). Proposed; the Trips code uses white at 14–16% (white text 4.0:1).

tokens.name: ticket-rule
tokens.usage: Dashed route lines, row dividers and dashed placeholders on a ticket (decorative).

tokens.name: ticket-highlight
tokens.usage: Overnight +1 markers on a ticket (4.6:1+ across the gradient), and the fill of the Want to try chip with on-accent ink. Proposed; the code has #fde68a.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Full-screen transport and globe backdrops; the globe draws its ocean, land and coast from card, background and border in the dark theme.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: DepartureBoard ground, a deep navy in both themes (with a border hairline in dark so it doesn't sink into the page).

tokens.name: board-cell
tokens.usage: Split-flap cells behind each character on the DepartureBoard (decorative).

tokens.name: on-board
tokens.usage: Board characters and the DUE status, warm flap-board yellow on navy (15:1).

tokens.name: board-muted
tokens.usage: Column headers and PAID/DONE status on the board (9:1).

tokens.name: board-late
tokens.usage: LATE status on the board (6.2:1), always as the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: stamp-fine
tokens.usage: RankStamp ink for the Fine tier: deep teal 5.5:1 light, bright teal 8.6:1 dark. Loved uses brand; Skip uses text-tertiary.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Navy ink for text and symbols on teal, amber, pink and yellow, and on the Want to try chip: 4.6–11:1. On blue, rose, violet and slate use white.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Group colour for travel and getting around (white content, 5.2:1): Trips and every city, flights, transit, gas and parking.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Group colour for health and self (on-accent content, 4.6:1): pharmacy, gym, doctor, Period.

tokens.name: accent-rose
tokens.usage: Group colour for fun and going out (white content, 4.7:1): Movies, concerts, bars, trip activities. Never on an amount, so it can't be read as money out.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Group colour for home and bills (white content, 5.7:1): rent, utilities, phone, insurance, trip stays.

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: A signal, not a group (on-accent content, 5.4:1): bars near their limit and the Want to try chip's outline. Never a section or category colour.

tokens.name: accent-pink
tokens.usage: Group colour for shopping and personal (on-accent content, 4.9:1): clothes, gifts, beauty, household goods.

tokens.name: accent-yellow
tokens.usage: Group colour for food and drink (on-accent content, 11:1): groceries, restaurants, coffee, Eats, Recipes, trip meals. A fill only: on white it is 1.5:1, so never a line, a thin bar or a small dot without its label, and never a button.

tokens.name: accent-slate
tokens.usage: Group colour for money moves (white content, 4.8:1): income, savings, transfers, fees. Also trip notes.

tokens.usage: Travel and getting around. Every SectionBand, CategoryTile and chart slice for this group uses it, in every module; items inside a group share it and differ by emoji or symbol.

tokens.name: group-food
tokens.usage: Food and drink. Every SectionBand, CategoryTile and chart slice for this group uses it, in every module; items inside a group share it and differ by emoji or symbol.

tokens.name: group-home
tokens.usage: Home and bills. Every SectionBand, CategoryTile and chart slice for this group uses it, in every module; items inside a group share it and differ by emoji or symbol.

tokens.usage: Health and self. Every SectionBand, CategoryTile and chart slice for this group uses it, in every module; items inside a group share it and differ by emoji or symbol.

tokens.name: group-fun
tokens.usage: Fun and going out. Every SectionBand, CategoryTile and chart slice for this group uses it, in every module; items inside a group share it and differ by emoji or symbol.

tokens.name: group-shopping
tokens.usage: Shopping and personal. Every SectionBand, CategoryTile and chart slice for this group uses it, in every module; items inside a group share it and differ by emoji or symbol.

tokens.name: group-money
tokens.usage: Money moves. Every SectionBand, CategoryTile and chart slice for this group uses it, in every module; items inside a group share it and differ by emoji or symbol.

tokens.usage: Trip plan kind Activity (figure.walk): the fun and going out group.

tokens.name: kind-meal
tokens.usage: Trip plan kind Meal (fork.knife): the food and drink group.

tokens.name: kind-transit
tokens.usage: Trip plan kind Travel (airplane): the travel group.

tokens.name: kind-stay
tokens.usage: Trip plan kind Stay (bed.double.fill): the home and bills group.

tokens.name: kind-note
tokens.usage: Trip plan kind Note (note.text).

tokens.name: launch-background
tokens.usage: Launch screen colour (LaunchBackground colorset).

tokens.name: logo-outline
tokens.usage: The sheep mark's outline, face and legs; fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: logo-inner
tokens.usage: The sheep mark's inner ears; fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: logo-wool
tokens.usage: The sheep mark's wool and eyes; white in both themes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy; ItemRow title at 500, amounts at 600.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: The app's most used style: CardHeader subtitle, ChangeLabel (500), secondary rows.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: The one big figure on a screen (net worth, left to spend), always tabular digits. Smaller money uses body or title3 at 600–700.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Detail-screen titles for places, movies and recipes (New York heavy). One size everywhere; Budget never uses it.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Airport and station codes and big rank numbers (SF Rounded black).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: SectionLabel (text-tertiary), ticket eyebrows (on-ticket), stamp tiers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tight: title to subtitle, icon to its label, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Inside a row: between inline items, badge padding, spacer before a trailing value.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Default: row padding, leading slot to text, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen side margins, ticket and band padding, gaps between sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between the hero ticket and the first section; around empty states.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Small: category tiles, posters, inputs, inset panels and stamps.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped form sections.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Heroes: TicketCard, SectionBand, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules and circles: buttons, badges, chips, bars, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Card lift, navy-tinted in light. Proposed; the code has .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.04), radius: 2, y: 1).

tokens.name: shadow-ticket
tokens.usage: Blue lift under a TicketCard (SwiftUI radius 10, y 5).

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Lift under a primary button only.
